description: Sharp insights into Amazon markets, traffic, and advertising — for market research, product research, traffic analysis, ad structure breakdown, competitor monitoring, reverse ASIN lookup, and other core seller workflows. Goes beyond raw data to deliver analysis and judgment. Officially provided by Sif (sif.com).

examples_en: Is 'yoga mat' still worth bidding on? Is demand growing or declining?

Which keywords drive traffic to this competitor ASIN? Where can I break in?
